description: Defines a test utility class 'TestDataSource' for nghttp2 data source testing, along with matcher functions for nghttp2 frame types.

classes.name: TestDataSource
classes.description: A simple class that can be adapted to act as a nghttp2_data_source, providing data for HTTP/2 frames in tests.

methods.name: ReadNext
methods.description: Reads the next chunk of data up to the specified size.

methods.name: SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects the payload length to send, up to max_length.

methods.name: MakeDataProvider
methods.description: Creates a nghttp2_data_provider object for the data source.
